import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductComparison

/-!
# The connecting map for a product with the circle

In the two-component coordinates of the antipodal overlap, the kernel of the
Mayer--Vietoris connecting map is exactly the diagonal. This supplies the shifted
cohomology summand in the circle-product calculation for Mumford, Chapter I,
Section 1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Coordinates on the cohomology of the two antipodal charts. -/
def circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v)) n ⊞
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X (-v))) n :
        ModuleCat ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n × IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  ((biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
    (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).symm ≪≫
      ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).toLinearEquiv

/-- Coordinates on the cohomology of the antipodal overlap. -/
def circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology
      (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) :
        Set (X × Circle))) n ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n × IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n ≪≫
    ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd _ _).toLinearEquiv

/-- The difference map in ordinary product coordinates. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_difference_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X n × IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
        (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n
        ((circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm a)) =
      (a.1 - a.2, a.1 - a.2) := by
  let A := IntegralSingularCohomology X n
  have h : (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).inv ≫
      (biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
        (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).hom ≫
      singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
        (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n ≫
      (circleProductIntersectionCohomologyIso X v n).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).hom =
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((LinearMap.fst ℤ A A - LinearMap.snd ℤ A A).prod
          (LinearMap.fst ℤ A A - LinearMap.snd ℤ A A)) := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun f => (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).inv ≫ f ≫
      (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).hom)
      (circleProductMayerVietoris_difference X v n)
    simp only [Category.assoc] at hm
    rw [hm]
    apply (cancel_mono (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).inv).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    apply biprod.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [biprod.lift_fst, Preadditive.comp_sub,
        ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]
      rfl
    · simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [biprod.lift_snd, Preadditive.comp_sub,
        ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst, ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun f => f a) h

/-- The actual open-cover connecting map, with its domain in overlap coordinates. -/
def circleProductCohomologyConnecting (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    (IntegralSingularCohomology X n × IntegralSingularCohomology X n) →ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (n + 1) :=
  (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
    (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 n).hom.comp
      (circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm.toLinearMap

/-- A class on the two overlap components has zero connecting class exactly
when the two components agree. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyConnecting_eq_zero_iff (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X n × IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n a = 0 ↔ a.1 = a.2 := by
  let e := circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n
  have hex := (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_intersection (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
      (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
      (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 n)
  change (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
    (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
    (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 n) (e.symm a) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [hex]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    have hm := circleProductMayerVietoris_difference_apply X v n
      (circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv X v n b)
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hb, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hm
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst hm).trans (congrArg Prod.snd hm).symm
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨(circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a.1, 0), ?_⟩
    apply e.injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n _ = a
    rw [circleProductMayerVietoris_difference_apply]
    simpa only [sub_zero] using (show (a.1, a.1) = a from Prod.ext rfl ha)

end Mumford.Analytic
